definition: For a truly fixed rule on untouched IID complete paths, the nominal one-sided95% exact upper solves P_p[X<=k]=.05, equivalently Beta(.95;k+1,n-k), with k=n boundary1. Here it is only a posthoc arithmetic illustration.
actual_limitations: Final121-180 was historically exposed before adaptive development; no fresh blind or confirmatory coverage is claimed.
Mixed-policy OOF outcomes and five dependent repeated partitions do not justify a naive fixed-policy IID binomial certificate.
Synthetic scenario laws are not verified real-market laws.
The95% level here is illustrative, not a newly registered acceptance criterion. No model adjustment or stopping rule is selected from these values.
distinction: L is customer peak real loss tolerance; alpha=.10 is a technical frequency convention. Neither alpha nor gamma nor reserve floors have been uniquely elicited as customer preference. Empiricalk/n<=alpha does not alone certify population p<=alpha.
